gaps.explanation: Three parts. (1) Missing fund columns: the governmental funds statement (p5) prints Sales Tax Fund (Sales tax 387,493, Interest income 2,798, Other 1,255; total 391,546), Economic Development Fund (Interest income 8,739, Other 1,300; total 10,039) and Keno Fund (Keno receipts 102,980, Interest income 1,109, Other 2,000; total 106,089) columns, none with a schedule; added below, 507,674 in all. (2) Different basis: the Debt Service Fund budgetary comparison schedule - cash basis (p18) prints Bond proceeds 620,000 among Resources (inflows) (total resources 794,642), while the statement prints it under Other Financing Sources as Bond/loan proceeds (p6) and not in Total revenues; detail index 85 (Bond proceeds 620,000) is a printed schedule line and is kept. (3) Different basis: the same cash-basis budget schedule has no Other line, while the statement's Debt Service column prints Other 3,283 (column total revenues 177,925 vs schedule property taxes 174,642; schedule net 19,456 vs statement net change 22,739, p6). Arithmetic: schedule 2,757,158 + 507,674 = 3,264,832; - 620,000 + 3,283 = 2,648,115 = statement total revenues (p5).
